units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 5) introducing into the personnel practices of federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies a rule requiring a state or municipal servant’s long, impeccable and effective performance of official duties to be taken into account when appointing the servant to a higher position, assigning a military or special rank, class rank or diplomatic rank, or granting incentives;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 6) developing public and parliamentary oversight institutions for compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: The main areas of state bodies’ activities to improve the effectiveness of combating corruption are:
units.label: Art. 7 · “The main areas of state bodies’ activities to improve the…”

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 1) pursuing a unified state anti-corruption policy;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 2) creating a mechanism for interaction between law enforcement and other state bodies and public and parliamentary commissions on anti-corruption matters, as well as citizens and civil society institutions;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 3) adopting legislative, administrative and other measures to encourage state and municipal servants and citizens to participate more actively in combating corruption and to foster a negative attitude toward corrupt conduct in society;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 4) improving the system and structure of state bodies and creating mechanisms for public oversight of their activities;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 5) introducing anti-corruption standards, namely establishing a unified system of prohibitions, restrictions and permissions for the relevant area of activity to ensure the prevention of corruption in that area;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 6) harmonizing the rights of state and municipal servants and persons holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, positions as heads of municipalities and municipal offices, as well as the restrictions, prohibitions and duties established for those servants and persons;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 7) ensuring citizens’ access to information on the activities of federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 8) ensuring the independence of the mass media;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 9) strict observance of the principles of judicial independence and noninterference in judicial activities;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 10) improving the organization of anti-corruption activities of law enforcement and supervisory bodies;
units.label: Point 10 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 11) improving the procedures for state and municipal service;
units.label: Point 11 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 12) ensuring good faith, openness, fair competition and objectivity in procurement of goods, works and services for state or municipal needs;
units.label: Point 12 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 13) eliminating unjustified prohibitions and restrictions, particularly in economic activity;
units.label: Point 13 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 14) improving procedures for using state and municipal property and state and municipal resources (including the provision of state and municipal assistance), and procedures for transferring rights to use such property and for its disposal;
units.label: Point 14 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 15) increasing the remuneration and social protection of state and municipal servants;
units.label: Point 15 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 16) strengthening international cooperation and developing effective forms of cooperation with law enforcement bodies, special services, financial intelligence units and other competent authorities of foreign states and international organizations in combating corruption and locating, confiscating and repatriating property obtained through corruption and held abroad;
units.label: Point 16 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 17) strengthening oversight of the resolution of matters raised in submissions by citizens and legal entities;
units.label: Point 17 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 18) transferring some functions of state bodies to self-regulatory organizations and other nongovernmental organizations;
units.label: Point 18 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 19) reducing the number of state and municipal servants while recruiting qualified specialists into state and municipal service;
units.label: Point 19 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 20) increasing the accountability of federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies and their officials for failing to take measures to eliminate the causes of corruption;
units.label: Point 20 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Main Areas of State Bodies’ Activities to Improve the Effectiveness of Combating Corruption
units.text: 21) optimizing and specifying the powers of state bodies and their employees, which must be reflected in administrative regulations and official job regulations.
units.label: Point 21 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.label: Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 1. In the cases provided for by Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 7 May 2013 ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’, the following persons are prohibited from opening and holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, and owning and/or using foreign financial instruments:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 1) persons holding:
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: а) state offices of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: б) the positions of First Deputy and Deputy Prosecutors General of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: в) positions as members of the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: г) state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: д) federal state service positions to which appointments and from which removals are made by the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation or the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: е) positions as deputy heads of federal executive bodies;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: ж) positions in state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws, to which appointments and from which removals are made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: з) positions as heads of urban okrugs, heads of municipal okrugs, heads of municipal districts, heads of other municipalities exercising the powers of heads of local administrations, and heads of local administrations;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: и) federal state service positions; state civil service positions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation; positions in the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws; and certain positions held under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, where the exercise of powers entails participation in preparing decisions affecting the sovereignty and national security of the Russian Federation, and which are included in lists established, respectively, by normative legal acts of federal state bodies and constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and normative acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, state corporations (companies), public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation and other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 1.1) deputies of representative bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs and urban okrugs exercising their powers on a full-time basis, and deputies holding positions in the representative bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs and urban okrugs;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 2) spouses and minor children of the persons specified in subpoints ‘а’–‘з’ of point 1 and in point 1.1 of this part;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 3) other persons in the cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 1.1. The concept of ‘foreign financial instruments’ is used in part 1 of this Article with the meaning defined by Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 7 May 2013 ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 2. The prohibition established by this Article on opening and holding accounts (deposits) in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation does not apply to persons specified in point 1 of part 1 of this Article who hold state offices of the Russian Federation or federal state service positions in official representations of the Russian Federation or official representations of federal executive bodies located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or positions in representations of state corporations (companies), public-law companies and organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, or to the spouses and minor children of those persons.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 7.1. Prohibition on Certain Categories of Persons Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located Outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments
units.text: 3. Failure to comply with the prohibition established by this Article, except in cases established by federal laws, entails early termination of powers, removal from the position held, or dismissal due to loss of trust in accordance with the federal constitutional laws and federal laws determining the legal status of the person concerned.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 7.1

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1. The following persons are obliged to submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations, and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouses and minor children, to the employer’s representative (employer) or other authorized persons designated by this Federal Law and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1) citizens applying for state service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.1) citizens applying for positions as members of the Board of Directors of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation or positions in the Central Bank of the Russian Federation included in a list approved by its Board of Directors;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.2) citizens applying for municipal service positions included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, or for the position of head of the local administration under a contract;
units.label: Point 1.2 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 2) citizens applying for positions included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation in state corporations, public-law companies, state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation or other organizations established by the Russian Federation under federal laws;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 2.1) citizens applying for the positions of Chief Financial Ombudsman or financial ombudsmen in financial services sectors (hereinafter also referred to as a financial ombudsman), or head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities;
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3) citizens applying for certain positions included in lists established by federal state bodies and held under employment contracts in organizations established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3.1) citizens applying for positions as heads of state (municipal) institutions;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3.2) state servants applying for state service positions included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3.2 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3.3) state servants and citizens applying for inclusion in the federal personnel reserve of the state civil service of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3.3 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3.4) state servants appointed to positions through transfer from another state body;
units.label: Point 3.4 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3.5) municipal servants applying for municipal service positions included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3.5 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 4) persons holding positions specified in point 1 of this part and included in lists established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and positions specified in points 1.1–3.1 of this part:
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: а) if the information provided for by this part was not submitted when the person was vested with the powers of a position to which appointment is made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, within four months of appointment to that position;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: б) if grounds arise for submitting information on expenditure under Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, no later than 30 April of the year following the year in which those grounds arose.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.1. Citizens entering higher education institutions under the authority of the federal executive body responsible for security are obliged to submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations and on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouses and minor children according to the procedure established by a normative legal act of the federal executive body responsible for security.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 1.2. Citizens called up for military service do not submit information on their income, property and property-related obligations or on the income, property and property-related obligations of their spouses and minor children.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 2. The procedure for submitting the information on income, property and property-related obligations specified in part 1 of this Article is established by federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and normative acts of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article is restricted-access information. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by a citizen under part 1 or 1.1 of this Article may not subsequently be used and must be destroyed if that citizen does not enter state or municipal service, take employment with the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, a state corporation (company), a public-law company, a state extrabudgetary fund of the Russian Federation, another organization established by the Russian Federation under a federal law, or an organization established to carry out tasks assigned to federal state bodies, take up the position of financial ombudsman, head of the service supporting the financial ombudsman’s activities or head of a state (municipal) institution, or enroll in a higher education institution under the authority of the federal executive body responsible for security. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article and classified by a federal law as information constituting a state secret is protected in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Submission of Information on Income, Property and Property-Related Obligations
units.text: 4. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by a citizen, servant or employee under parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article may not be used to establish or determine their solvency or that of their spouse and minor children, or to collect, directly or indirectly, donations (contributions) to the funds of public associations, religious or other organizations, or for the benefit of individuals.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 8
